title: How big is a 1 carat heart?

hook.text: How big is a 1 carat heart?

post.youtube_title: How big is a 1 carat heart?
post.caption:
A 1 carat heart measures about 6.5 by 6.5 millimeters. A 2 carat heart covers 50% of the width of a size 6 finger.

Heart diamond size chart: https://www.heygema.com/en/gem-size/heart-diamond-size-chart?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=shorts&utm_campaign=gem_size_shorts

Estimates for a well-cut stone.
